_doc: Edge-class conventions for LimeZu-style autotile sheet layouts, encoded as
data (the task rule: convention lives in data, not code). Each convention
describes a block of tiles by a 3x3 SUBGRID per cell: rows top->bottom,
chars left->right, 'A' = the block's primary terrain, 'B' = its secondary
(the terrain it transitions into). Side signatures derive from the subgrid:
N = row0 (read W->E), S = row2 (W->E), W = col0 (N->S), E = col2 (N->S).
Two placed tiles are edge-compatible when the facing side signatures,
resolved through each block's primary/secondary terrain names, are equal.
blob3x3: the classic 3x3 terrain blob (outer corners + edges + full center)
used by LimeZu Serene Village / Modern Exteriors ground sets.
inner2x2: the 2x2 inner-corner (concave notch) companion block.
solid: any plain fill tile (primary everywhere); size scales to the block.
